title: Wanda Gwajin Ruwa Ya Hana
intro: A cikin tarihin littattafan da suka gabata, akwai wani mutum mai ban sha'awa wanda labarinsa bai fara da wani abin al'ajabi ko wahayi mai ƙarfi ba, amma da gwaji mai sauƙi amma mai zurfi na bangaskiya. Wata al'umma ta tsaya a kan mahadar hanya, tana neman jagorancin Allah don jagoranci. Abin da ya faru gwaji ne mai wayo wanda zai bayyana masu imani na gaskiya a cikinsu. Za ku iya warware wannan asiri daga alamun da aka bari a baya?
clues: Na fito daga zuri'ar da mutane ke yabawa, kuma Allah ya zaɓe ni don wata manufa mai tsarki da ba za su iya fahimta ba.
Jikina yana ɗauke da alamar fifiko wanda wasu ba su da shi, wanda hakan ya sa na bambanta tsakanin mutanena.
Lokacin da aka ayyana cewa kogin ya gwada, yawancinsu sun juya baya—amma na ci gaba da tafiya, ina da imani mara misaltuwa ga alkawarin Allah.
An umarce ni da kada in taɓa shan ruwan da aka haramta, duk da haka digo ɗaya ya fito daga leɓunana—zunubi da ke damun zuciyata har abada.
Allah ya ƙaddara ni da in haɗu da wani matashi makiyayi wanda wata rana zai zama shahararre saboda kashe babban abokin gaba.
Lokacin da rundunonin suka yi karo, ban faɗi ta hannun maƙiyi ba, sai dai ta hanyar umarnin Allah a matsayin hukunci saboda rashin biyayyata a kogin.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
